_what: the blast radius of the valB_mini FAIL, derived quantity by quantity, plus the two things the n=3 result newly makes measurable: a bound on sigma_leg and the replicate-SD/MBAR-SE factor on this pipeline.
_not_a_price: no cost, throughput or basis is computed here; pricing.md and STRATEGY own those.

inputs_measured._source: paper §2.11 (nr4a3-degrader-paper.md), reduced 2026-07-30 by the official reducer from the 4 replicate legs that landed 3:07 AM ET. Those are the narrative home; this dict is the machine copy the derivations below consume.
inputs_measured._cycle_sd_is_a_sigma_edge: 0.375 is the between-replicate SD of ddG_coop itself -- a per-EDGE spread (ternary minus binary), which is `sigma_edge` in closure_noise_floor's notation, NOT a per-leg sigma. §1 does the conversion.

1_sigma_leg_now_bounded.what_changed: closure_noise_floor records `sigma_leg_is_unknown_by_a_factor_of` 15.6 and says 'nothing in this lane has measured it'. The n=3 replicates measured it.
1_sigma_leg_now_bounded.relation_used: SD(R) = sqrt(6) * sigma_leg = sqrt(3) * sigma_edge (independent legs, +-1 coefficients)

why_it_is_an_upper_bound_not_a_value.a_homology_model_swap: valB seed s starts from the s%n-th relaxed SMARCA2 model, so 0.375 contains model-swap variance. The triangle is single-seed by construction (same_seed_requirement), which removes that term.
why_it_is_an_upper_bound_not_a_value.b_independent_solvation: the n=3 reduction flags system identity INCONSISTENT -- the ternary arm differs from itself in particle count across seeds -- so 0.375 also carries solvation variability. STRATEGY already reports it as an upper bound on the sampling-only SD.

1_sigma_leg_now_bounded.consequence: the design's sigma_leg = 0.5 and 0.7 rows -- where power to resolve an r0-sized miss is 0.22 and 0.14 -- are now EXCLUDED BY MEASUREMENT. The triangle is graded against the interval [0.045, 0.2652].

1b_power_at_measured_bound.graded_at: the measured UPPER bound, so every figure is a worst case within the bounded interval
1b_power_at_measured_bound.reading: power to detect an r0-sized (1.478 kcal/mol) path error is 0.63 at the upper bound and 1.00 at the lower one. That interval is NOT a clean pass -- 0.63 is mediocre power and the honest statement is that the triangle's adequacy depends on where in the bounded interval the true sigma_leg sits. What the measurement DID buy is the exclusion of the range where the triangle was hopeless: the design's own 0.5 and 0.7 rows give 0.22 and 0.14, and those are now ruled out.

2_frozen_rule_vs_measured_power.frozen_proxy: binary_departure_prereg demotes BINARY_CANCELS -> UNDERPOWERED when sigma_leg > 0.2
2_frozen_rule_vs_measured_power.the_finding: the frozen proxy (0.200) and the computed 0.80-power crossing (0.215) agree to ~7%. The hand-set number was very nearly right, which is the opposite of what a 'the proxy is misfiring' reading would have predicted.
2_frozen_rule_vs_measured_power.why_not: at the measured upper bound the power is 0.63, which a conventional 0.80 threshold demotes anyway. The amendment changes the LABEL's justification, not the verdict -- so it must not be sold as unlocking the diagnostic.
2_frozen_rule_vs_measured_power.action_taken_here: NONE. Recorded before R lands; the rule is untouched.
2_frozen_rule_vs_measured_power.action_proposed_to_trimcrae: a dated defect-fix that REPORTS the computed power beside the verdict, keeping the demotion rule itself. Value is transparency: 'UNDERPOWERED' currently cannot distinguish power 0.63 from 0.05, and those warrant different responses. $0. LOW STAKES -- graded that way because the measurement says so, not to make it easy to approve.
2_frozen_rule_vs_measured_power.the_honest_residual: a null R at the upper bound is worth ~0.63 power, which does not make a null strong evidence, amended or not. The triangle can ADMIT the cycle more confidently than it can convict it -- the design's own asymmetry, not a new problem. ⚠ AND THE VERDICT GENUINELY TURNS ON WHERE IN [0.045, 0.2652] THE TRUE sigma_leg SITS: below ~0.215 a null R clears 0.80 power and is readable; at the upper bound it is not. Since the bound is an UPPER bound, the true value is plausibly on the readable side -- but that is an argument, and §7 is how it becomes a measurement.

3_error_algebra.quantity: ddG_coop (valB_mini; the NR4A ternary cooperativity matrix it gates)
3_error_algebra.why: the two environments differ by an entire protein chain. Measured on this lane: ~144k vs ~90k particles, and the binary arm's ligand departs its pocket in 8/12 replicas where the ternary arm is 12/12 clean. Almost nothing about the two error terms is shared.
3_error_algebra.status: MEASURED FAILURE -- abs error 1.543 kcal/mol at n=3
3_error_algebra.consequence: NR4A ternary cooperativity scores stay EXPLORATORY. This is the claim the FAIL actually costs, and it is the only one it costs directly.

3_error_algebra.expression: e(d0->d | ternary, NR4A3) - e(d0->d | ternary, NR4A1)
3_error_algebra.cancellation: ALGEBRAIC on the binary and solvent legs, NUMERICAL and strong on the rest
3_error_algebra.why: the binary leg is the construct + CRBN with no target chain, so it is the SAME leg for both species and drops out of the expression exactly -- `nr4a3_5aks_reduce` REFUSES a binary leg rather than warning, for this reason. What remains is one morph of ONE ATOM (aromatic C-H -> N) evaluated in two homologous pockets at matched ternary architecture. That is the most favourable cancellation configuration in the ladder, and the exact opposite of the contrast that failed.
3_error_algebra.status: NOT DIRECTLY IMPLICATED by the valB FAIL
3_error_algebra.consequence: survives the FAIL on algebra -- but see §4: 'not implicated' is an argument, not a measurement, and S has its own separate resolvability problem.

3_error_algebra.quantity: ddG_bind (RUNG 4 step-1 fan-out; the 18-edge congeneric map)
3_error_algebra.cancellation: NUMERICAL, and validated independently of anything ternary
3_error_algebra.why: a congeneric binary RBFE, the class valA_mini reproduced against a known answer and the cmpd19 pilot converged on the real system. It contains no ternary-vs-binary contrast at all, so valB's error term does not appear in it.
3_error_algebra.consequence: the delivered congeneric map stands on its own gates; the FAIL does not reach it.

3_error_algebra.expression: sum of e around a closed 3-cycle, within ONE environment
3_error_algebra.cancellation: the true terms telescope exactly; per-endpoint STATE-FUNCTION error telescopes too
3_error_algebra.why: valb_triangle_closure verified this numerically two ways -- max |R| ~ 1e-14 over 20,000 random state-function draws. So closure sees ONLY the non-conservative part of the error and is BLIND to force field, homology model, NAGL charges, protonation and the reference data.
3_error_algebra.status: IN FLIGHT -- the diagnostic, not a claim
3_error_algebra.consequence: R_ternary is the only measurement in the program that speaks to the error class S is exposed to. §4 is what it licenses.

3_error_algebra.quantity: the categorical axes (Tier 0 unique-residue map, Tier 1 atlas, Tier 2 basins/reach)
3_error_algebra.expression: not a free-energy difference at all
3_error_algebra.why: these are geometric and sequence-derived: exposure, divergence, reach distance, collision fraction, lysine presentation. No alchemical morph appears anywhere in them.
3_error_algebra.consequence: the paper's selectivity spine does not route through the failed quantity. This is why the program has somewhere to stand.

4_s_resolvability_prereg.registered: 2026-07-30, while the two ternary triangle legs were still running

rule.ADMIT: |R_ternary| below its own resolution threshold (0.900) -- no detectable non-conservative error in the ternary environment. The resume is bought.
rule.HOLD: |R_ternary| resolved but under 1.372 -- real path error, but not enough to swamp S. Buy the resume AND carry the measured floor as S's uncertainty, not the MBAR SE.
rule.STOP_AND_REDRAW: |R_ternary| at or above 1.372 -- S's inherited noise floor exceeds what S can resolve, so finishing the legs buys a number that cannot answer its own question. Per the asymmetry above this is a HOLD FOR A SECOND DRAW, never a kill on one sample.

4_s_resolvability_prereg._blind_spot_stated: closure is blind to per-endpoint state-function error, so an ADMIT verdict bounds the non-conservative class ONLY. State-function error that differs between the NR4A3 and NR4A1 pockets is invisible to R_ternary and to every other check this program has. For S that residual is a SECOND difference of a ONE-ATOM morph across two homologous pockets, which is the configuration in which it is smallest -- but small-by-argument is not measured, and this file will not pretend otherwise.
4_s_resolvability_prereg.verdict: NOT YET MEASURED -- this is the pre-registration, not a result

5_s_error_bar_scope.configuration: two parked legs, seed 0, one per arm -> reduce_S returns COMPUTED_SINGLE_SEED
5_s_error_bar_scope._ratio_basis: MEASURED on this pipeline at n=3: cycle SD 0.375 against per-leg MBAR SEs 0.097-0.132. Before today this factor was assumed; now it is not.
5_s_error_bar_scope.reading: at one seed per arm S resolves ~1.04 kcal/mol once the measured replicate/MBAR factor is applied, against a designed effect of 0.5-1.5. It can therefore see the TOP of its own effect range and not the bottom, so a null S at n=1 is uninterpretable in precisely the way valB's n=1 was.

options.finish_as_configured: buy the two parked legs, report S as a point estimate, and label it exploratory. Retires paper §2.10(d) 'the causal test has not been run' but cannot support a null.
options.add_one_seed_per_arm: two further legs give S a real replicate SD and make a null readable. ⚠ CHECK BEFORE BUYING: the SMARCA2 lane's seed -> relaxed-model map wraps at n_models=2 (tests/test_edge_reps_seed_independence.py). Whether the 5a-KS co-fold staging has the same wrap is UNVERIFIED here and must be checked, not assumed, or the second seed re-runs the first model and buys no independence.

6_estimator_note.preregistered_estimator: Welch-Satterthwaite over independently averaged ternary and binary arms
6_estimator_note.what_is_unaffected: the FAIL itself. Wrong sign and |mean - target| = 1.543 on a 1.0 band are both estimator-independent.
6_estimator_note.what_is_affected: only the reading that the method 'resolves a cooperativity change confidently', which rests on the tighter preregistered interval.
6_estimator_note.action: record it in the paper's limitations rather than switch estimators. A referee who recomputes the paired interval should find we got there first.

7_narrow_sigma_leg_from_triangle_legs.method: sigma_leg(triangle) ~ ratio * mean per-leg MBAR SE of the TRIANGLE's own legs, where the ratio is the replicate-SD/MBAR-SE factor measured at n=3 on this lane
7_narrow_sigma_leg_from_triangle_legs.what_it_would_settle: whether a null R clears conventional power. Below the crossing it does and the triangle answers its question; above it, it does not, amended or not.
7_narrow_sigma_leg_from_triangle_legs.cost: $0 -- the MBAR SEs are already in the leg records that land with R
7_narrow_sigma_leg_from_triangle_legs.when: the moment all four legs are down, alongside task=triangle-reduce
7_narrow_sigma_leg_from_triangle_legs.estimate: NOT YET COMPUTABLE -- the triangle's ternary legs have not landed
